evals.name: multi-part-request-routes
evals.prompt: I need to add a --quiet flag to `doflow doctor`, then document it in docs/reference.md, then get the whole thing reviewed.
evals.expected_output: do decomposes the request into three parts against real targets in this repo and names which skill owns each

assertions.text: The documentation part is routed to do-document by name
The review part is routed to do-code-review by name
Response decomposes the request into 3 distinct parts rather than treating it as one job

evals.name: estimation-is-ranged-not-false-precision
evals.prompt: /do --estimate Add an eighth harness adapter to this repo: a registry entry in harnesses.yaml/contracts.yaml/assets.yaml, a src/adapters/<id>/index.js implementing the six-function contract, dispatch wiring, and the guard updates that keeps.
evals.expected_output: An effort estimate grounded in the seven adapters that already exist, with its assumptions stated, rather than a single false-precision number

assertions.text: The estimate labels its assumptions explicitly
The estimate is grounded in the existing adapters rather than generic guesswork
Estimate is a range or is qualified, not a bare single number presented as certain

evals.name: simple-question-does-not-over-route
evals.prompt: What does the `--prune` flag do in doflow remove?
evals.expected_output: A direct, correct answer about backup retention; the dispatcher should not spin up a multi-skill decomposition

assertions.text: The answer explains --prune in terms of backup retention, which is what the flag actually does
Answers directly without decomposing into a multi-skill plan

evals.name: single-skill-review-does-not-route
evals.expected_output: do does not route this request; it belongs to do-code-review

assertions.text: the run judged this repo's do description (sandbox path, matching hash)
do is not used: routing.json records routed false

evals.name: plain-change-request-resolves-to-do
evals.prompt: Make `node bench/runner.js parity` print the number of pending cases on its first output line.
evals.expected_output: do is invoked for a plain change request that names no skill, states the task class, and routes the change to do-implement

assertions.text: The change is routed to do-implement by name
The task class is stated before the request is routed

evals.name: programme-ask-proposes-program-mode
evals.prompt: Build out an onboarding, billing and notification system for the product as one big goal.
evals.expected_output: do recognizes a programme-sized ask with multiple independently shippable outcomes and proposes program mode to the person before running research or writing roadmap rows

assertions.text: proposes program mode through the question tool before any research; no roadmap write

evals.name: single-feature-ask-skips-program-mode
evals.prompt: Add a --dry-run flag to `doflow roadmap seed` across src/cli/runtime-commands.ts, src/runtime/roadmap/seed.ts, and docs/reference.md.
evals.expected_output: do treats a single-feature request touching multiple files as an ordinary change, skips program mode, and states the task class

assertions.text: routes as an ordinary change with the class stated; does not propose or enter program mode (saying it is not program-sized is compliant)
